description:
Welcome to 5650 Carlingford Ave, a well-maintained single-story home located in an established Riverside neighborhood known for its spacious lots, mature trees, and convenient central location. This 3-bedroom, 2-bath home offers a functional layout with bright living spaces, updated flooring, an inviting dining area, and a clean kitchen featuring butcher block countertops and ample cabinet storage. The living room provides a comfortable setting for everyday living and entertaining, while the spacious backyard and covered patio create the perfect extension for gatherings, relaxing evenings, or future customization.

Situated on a generously sized lot with a long driveway, attached garage, and a variety of mature fruit trees, the property offers both charm and practicality. The outdoor space provides room to garden, entertain, or simply enjoy the Southern California lifestyle.

Conveniently located near the 91 Freeway, this home offers easy access to shopping, dining, and entertainment, including Galleria at Tyler, Downtown Riverside, UC Riverside, local parks, schools, and Riverside Community Hospital. Whether you’re a first-time buyer, growing household, or someone looking for a home with space and potential in a well-established neighborhood, this property is one you won’t want to miss.
